design: All56 frozen receivers; six common-norm directions (near/far x block/PCA/random). Response is edited minus SAME RECEIVER zero-edit logits, weighted-centered under native recipient probabilities then multiplied by sqrt(p). Uniform-centered logit response is secondary.
metric: Cosine of Fisher-local logit response vectors; finite changes so not an exact KL metric. Gram participation rank of six normalized directions measures angular concentration, not full Jacobian rank.
noise: Weighted norm of zero-edit minus native logits; mark pairs as >10x replay discrepancy for both responses; retain all rows and no outcome-based removal.
scope: Descriptive posthoc analysis on H825; no out-of-sample prediction, semantic labels or new forwards.
